title: Decoding silent reading from non-invasive EEG
abstract: arXiv:2608.20186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-invasive decoding of inner speech faces a fundamental data problem: a corpus pairing brain activity with a person's spontaneous inner monologue cannot be collected, and the available proxy paradigms (cued repetitive and retrospectively reported generative inner speech) are slow to acquire, poorly time-locked, and subject compliance is unverifiable. We therefore treat silent reading as a scalable proxy task and ask how much lexical and semantic information a contrastive decoder can extract from it. We report an open-vocabulary analysis of approximately 240,000 word presentations recorded from a single densely-sampled participant across 393 runs (ca. 49 h) of 19-channel dry-electrode EEG. Words from continuous narrative text were presented in rapid serial visual presentation, with typography randomised on every trial to partially decorrelate word identity from low-level visual form. translated_title: 从非侵入性脑电中解码默读
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20186v1 公告类型：新 摘要：非侵入式解码内心独白面临一个根本性的数据问题：无法收集将脑活动与一个人自发的内心独白配对的数据集，而现有的代理范式（线索重复性和回顾性报告生成性内心独白）采集速度慢、时间锁定不佳，且受试者依从性难以验证。因此，我们将默读视为一种可扩展的代理任务，并探讨对比解码器能从其中提取多少词汇和语义信息。我们报告了一项开放词汇分析，涉及来自单一密集采样参与者的约24万次单词呈现，跨越393次运行（约49小时）的19通道干电极脑电数据。连续叙事文本中的单词以快速序列视觉呈现方式展示，每次试验的字体排版随机化，以部分去相关单词身份与低级视觉形式。一个卷积脑电编码器，可选地后接...
tldr: 本研究利用非侵入性脑电和对比解码器，通过默读作为代理任务，成功从约24万次单词呈现中提取出词汇和语义信息，展示了非侵入式解码内心独白的可行性。
en_tdlr: This study uses non-invasive EEG and a contrastive decoder, leveraging silent reading as a scalable proxy task, to successfully extract lexical and semantic information from approximately 240,000 word presentations, demonstrating the feasibility of decoding inner speech non-invasively.
